name: Sherlock
description: Sherlock (sherlock-project) is a local username-search OSINT command-line tool, not a hosted API.
auth_notes: The CLI runs locally; sources show no outbound API credentials for the GitHub Sherlock project.
gate_detail: Nothing to sign up for: the tool is installed locally via pipx. No hosted first-party API is described. Other Sherlock products in the sources (Ansys, Synopsys, Sherlocks.ai) are different products.
api_scope: Local username enumeration across many social platforms via the CLI; no hosted developer API is documented in the sources.
mcp_notes: Third-party sherlock-mcp wraps the local Sherlock CLI; no vendor-published MCP server shown.
blocker_detail: Sherlock is a local CLI OSINT tool; the MCP server found is a third-party wrapper, and other Sherlock-named products are different vendors.

evidence.quote: FastMCP server integration for the Sherlock OSINT tool
Sherlock CLI tool installed: pipx install sherlock-project
This starts the MCP server with stdio transport, ready for MCP clients.

issues: The S1 GitHub page text is largely navigation; the sources say little directly about the project.
Other Sherlock products (Ansys, Synopsys, Sherlocks.ai) are different vendors and were excluded.
No outbound auth statement for the CLI is directly given.
